description: This file defines the LoanSchedulePlanDisbursementPeriod class, which models a period within a loan schedule disbursement plan, containing date and amount details.

classes.name: LoanSchedulePlanDisbursementPeriod
classes.description: Immutable class representing a disbursement period within a loan schedule, implementing the LoanSchedulePlanPeriod interface.

methods.name: periodNumber
methods.description: Returns the period number; currently returns null, possibly to be implemented or overridden in subclasses.

methods.name: periodFromDate
methods.description: Getter for the start date of the period.

methods.name: periodDueDate
methods.description: Getter for the due date of the period.
